item.title: gitalk
item.description:
Gitalk评论登录跳转异常

添加新文章，需要初始化评论，点击使用GitHub登录，地址栏变成了 https://gh1656409967.github.io/?error=redirect_uri_mismatch&error_description=The+redirect_uri+MUST+match+the+registered+callback+URL+for+this+application.&error_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.github.com%2Fapps%2Fmanaging-oauth-apps%2Ftroubleshooting-authorization-request-errors%2F%23redirect-uri-mismatch

跳转链接中给出了相关提示，“重定向uri必须与此应用程序的已注册回调URL匹配”。
